 Newcastle now preparing official bid to sign £33m Champions League 'baller'
 Originally posted on
 Football FanCast 
  | 
 By Dominic Lund
  | 
 Last updated Nov 2, 2026 7:10 AM ET
 Add us as a preferred source on Google
 Newcastle United are now preparing an offer for a "baller", and there are encouraging signs that a deal could be possible.
 The Magpies were forced into a major rebuild in the summer, after losing the likes of Anthony Gordon , Sandro Tonali and Bruno Guimaraes, which led to the arrival of three new midfielders. 
 Nico Gonzalez , Sean Steur and Aladji Bamba arrived at St. James' Park, while Joelinton and Joe Willock also continue to hold down consistent places in the starting XI. 
 However, it has been a topsy-turvy season for Newcastle to date, having taken 11 points from their opening eight matches, a record that leaves them 12th in the table, albeit with a game in hand on every team above them.
 Jaissle's side are likely to rise to seventh, should they defeat Everton at home on Monday night, and they will be looking to get revenge on the Toffees after suffering a 3-1 defeat at the Hill Dickinson Stadium last time out, which confirmed their exit from the EFL Cup.
 Things could have been very different for the Magpies, who recorded an xG of 3.34, compared to just 1.61 from the hosts, but they squandered three of the four big chances they created.
 If things continue in that manner, Jaissle may be forced to strengthen his attacking options, and talks have been held regarding a deal for AS Monaco star Folarin Balogun , but the St. James' Park outfit are also looking to improve their midfield.
 Newcastle readying bid for Gabriel Sara 
 According to a report from Germany, Newcastle are now preparing an official offer of around £25m for Galatasaray star Gabriel Sara , although that may not be enough to tempt the Turkish side into a sale.
 The Brazilian's current employers are open to negotiating a sale, but they are looking to hold out for €40m (£33m), amid widespread interest from across Europe.
 The Magpies' opponents on Monday night, Everton, are also readying an offer for Sara, while Napoli and AS Roma headline the interest from Italy.
 Galatasaray teammate Victor Osimhen may be disappointed if his teammate moves on, after saying last season: "He has been one of our best players. We rely on him, and he deserves it." 
 The Nigerian striker also described the central midfielder as a "proper baller", and he has started to gain experience in the Champions League, making 15 appearances across the past two seasons.
 Gabriel Sara is one of my favourite players in the championship. On my â€˜if Leeds get promotedâ€™ list as a MUST sign.Ridiculously talented and if someone gets him now theyâ€™ll save the Â£50m+ heâ€™d cost in the future. pic.twitter.com/WHWxiEXEUD — Ben Mattinson (@Ben_Mattinson_) March 11, 2024 
 That said, there are doubts surrounding whether Newcastle need to sign a new midfielder, considering they already have a plethora of options.
 Signing a striker should perhaps be the priority instead, considering William Osula , Yoane Wissa and Matias Fernandez-Pardo have scored just two goals between them in the Premier League this season.
